description: This source file provides utility functions for testing in Go, including creating temporary directories, removing directories, writing files, and handling errors.

methods.name: TempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a unique name, returning its path. Terminates the test if directory creation fails.

methods.name: RemoveDir
methods.description: Removes the specified directory, terminating the test if removal fails.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file with specified permissions. Returns an error if writing fails.

methods.name: FatalIfNil
methods.description: Checks if an error is nil, causes test to fail if not.
